1. Objective: Retrieve IC50 activity records with provenance for CHEMBL3716726 and all its salt forms against target CHEMBL375. Return one row per activity record including compound identifiers, structures, assay details, and literature references.

2. Output: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism

3. Source: molecule_dictionary (parent), molecule_hierarchy, molecule_dictionary (child), compound_structures, compound_records, activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs

4. Logic: Identify parent compound by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3716726'. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno to retrieve all child molregnos. Include parent row via UNION or explicit inclusion. Join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on molregno, then activities on record_id. Filter activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Join assays on assay_id and target_dictionary on tid. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL375'. Join docs on doc_id to derive pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi). Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
